project.title: Future Princess Cosplay
project.description: A cosplay of Future Princess from Guardian Tales. The project involved creating the character's armor and, most notably, a seven-foot-tall scythe made from materials collected and saved from previous projects, with the exception of EVA foam purchased online.

project.title: Pokemon Mezastar Collection Display
project.description: From December 20, 2025, to January 30, 2026, all 70 Version 1 Pokémon Mezastar tags were collected. After completing the collection, an unused portrait frame was repurposed and decorated with Pokémon-themed designs to create a display showcasing the tags.

project.title: Art Gallery
project.description: An ongoing art gallery showcasing traditional and digital artworks of characters from various favorite fandoms.
